instruction: Write an XDP program that must decapsulate basic GRE tunnels (proto 47) stripping outer IPv4 and 4-byte GRE header. Forward all packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Verify Ethernet and outer IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Calculate total encapsulation length: (outer_ip->ihl * 4) + 4 bytes GRE header
Back up Ethernet header and shift packet head forward by outer_len + 4 using bpf_xdp_adjust_head
Re-validate packet pointers and restore Ethernet header with ETH_P_IP
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration

tests.name: pass_decap_gre
tests.description: GRE tunnel packet decapsulated and passed
